ValidationRule.description: When I have selected a customer profile in CCRM and viewing details Then I should see customer address from CACHE systems
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $Profile.Name = $Label.CCRM_Profile_Name, NOT( ISBLANK( Customer_Name__c ) ), Customer_Name__r.Source_System_Name__c = 'CACHE', OR( Customer_Name__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PersonAccount', Customer_Name__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Business_Account' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Unsupported customer profile selected. Please choose a valid CAP customer profile to proceed.
